fact: The Minister for State President, exercising powers under section 1 of the Data Protection Act, 2024, made the Data Protection Act (Date of Commencement) Order, 2025 (S.I. No. 4 of 2025) on 13 January 2025, bringing the Act into operation on 14 January 2025.
title: Data Protection Act (Date of Commencement) Order, 2025 (Statutory Instrument No. 4 of 2025)
publisher: Botswana Government Gazette Extraordinary (Government Printing and Publishing Services)
